published_value.explain: Schedule D line 2, column (h), is your short-term Form 8949 box B gain or loss, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 2, column (h), is zero because your box B proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: You said you have no short-term sales whose basis was not reported, so Schedule D line 2, column (h), is zero.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 2, column (h), has no value yet. It is waiting for the basis of a short-term sale whose basis was not reported to the IRS.
